title: Historic and Modern Aircraft Coming to MSFS Marketplace
description:
This April 30, 2026 Marketplace Update for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 on PC brings a standout release that will instantly grab the attention of airliner and warbird fans alike — the Aeroplane Heaven DH98 Mosquito. Alongside this legendary "Wooden Wonder," the high-detail PMDG 737-700 has finally arrived in the in-sim marketplace, headlining a solid batch of new liveries and missions joining the sim this week!

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Aeroplane Heaven: de Havilland DH98 Mosquito (The legendary "Wooden Wonder" twin-engine bomber)
🛫 PMDG: Boeing 737-700 (High-detail NG expansion including BBJ and Cargo variants)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 PMDG: 737-700 Livery Pack "Americas" (Dozens of high-res US-based airliners)
🎨 PMDG: 737-700 Livery Pack "Europe/Asia/Africa/Oceania" (Massive global airline expansion)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-200ER Livery Pack 41 (American, Delta, New Zealand)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-200ER Livery Pack 40 (United, Star Alliance, EcoDemonstrator)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-300ER Livery Pack 42 (Qatar, China Southern, Ethiopian)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-Freighter Livery Pack 43 (Korean, MK Air, Kalita Air)
🎨 2Pilot: Beige Cockpit Mod (For Boeing 747-8 & 787-10)  

🕒 Chapters
00:00 - Intro
00:31 - Historic piston power: DeHavilland DH-98 Mosquito
03:14 - The airliner essential: PMDG 737-700
06:31 - The Captain Sim 777 collection
08:08 - Cockpit customization

If you enjoyed this weekly Marketplace update, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below with your favourite new aircraft or livery from this release!
Thanks for watching and happy flying.

✈️ See you in the skies!
